mission.description: The primary mission or purpose of this knowledge. Explain what this knowledge exists to achieve in one concise paragraph.

items.description: A single policy or guideline that should normally be followed.

policies.description: General principles or recommended behaviors. These describe what should usually be done, but are not absolute requirements.

items.description: A single mandatory constraint or requirement.

constraints.description: Hard requirements that must always be satisfied. Violating these constraints makes the output incorrect.

items.description: A single thing that is intentionally outside the scope of this knowledge.

nonGoals.description: Explicitly state what this knowledge is not intended to solve or cover. This helps avoid scope creep and incorrect assumptions.

definition.description: A concise explanation of the meaning of the term within this project.

terminology.description: Definitions of project-specific terminology. Include only terms that may be ambiguous or unfamiliar.

items.description: Explain one design decision and why it exists.

rationale.description: Important reasoning behind decisions, trade-offs, or architectural choices. Focus on "why" rather than "what".

situation.description: Describe the context or situation in which this guidance should be applied.

guidance.description: Explain the recommended action, behavior, or workflow that should be followed in this situation.

items.description: One recommended usage pattern consisting of a situation and the corresponding guidance.

usage.description: Recommended ways to apply this knowledge in practice. Each entry describes when the guidance applies and what should be done.

title.description: A short descriptive title that summarizes the example.

input.description: The input, request, or initial situation presented to the system. Use Markdown when formatting improves readability.

output.description: The expected or recommended output produced from the input. Use Markdown when appropriate.

explanation.description: Explain why this output is considered correct and what principle or policy it demonstrates.

items.description: A complete worked example demonstrating how this knowledge should be applied.

examples.description: Concrete examples showing correct application of this knowledge. Examples should be realistic, representative, and suitable for few-shot prompting.

title: Knowledge
description: Structured knowledge provided to an LLM. It defines the mission, expected behaviors, limitations, terminology, rationale, recommended usage, and practical examples for a specific topic.
